argument_summary: The admissible record supports certification only in a caveated form. Aggregate readiness exceeds threshold and launch rehearsal had no severity-one incidents, which supports deployment readiness. But the same record also shows a remaining weakness in the named enterprise refund workflow, concentrated in refund-policy summarization, and the draft mitigation runbook is incomplete because required governance fields remain TBD. Under the stated policy, that means the supportable position is certification with explicit model-card disclosure of the limitation, not a clean statement that no known material limitations exist.
claims_about_policy: The governing policy does not permit caveat-free certification on this record because certification without material caveats requires either evidence that no material weakness remains or an approved mitigation with owner, threshold, review date, and rollback criterion. The current draft runbook does not satisfy that standard. The release policy separately requires disclosure of material limitations for named launch use cases unless resolved or covered by approved risk acceptance before launch. Public model-card and AI-risk guidance support documenting limitations and monitoring, but they do not replace those policy predicates.
claims_about_business_cost: No escalation is necessary if the auditor accepts the narrower certification position already supported by the admissible record: certify deployment readiness conditioned on correcting the model-card statement and disclosing the refund-workflow limitation. That preserves launch velocity better than challenging the policy standard or demanding a clean-certification theory that the current evidence does not support.
concessions: The current model-card draft statement that there are no known material limitations is not supported by the admissible record.
The unresolved refund-workflow issue remains a material limitation for a named launch use case unless resolved or covered by approved risk acceptance.
The draft mitigation runbook is not sufficient governance cover for caveat-free certification because key fields remain TBD.
